title: Associate – Software Development Engineer, Procurement Technology
description:
blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. blackstone’s over $1\.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. further information is available at www.blackstone.com. follow @blackstone on linkedin, x (twitter), and instagram.

**business unit**


bxti – corporate finance technology

**role summary**


we are seeking a highly motivated software development engineer to join blackstone's procurement technology team within corporate finance technology. this role is ideal for an engineer with experience building enterprise applications, apis, and cloud\-based integrations who is eager to work at the intersection of software engineering and business operations. the successful candidate will develop and support solutions that power procurement processes, supplier integrations, analytics, and financial operations across the firm. working closely with product owners, business stakeholders, and fellow engineers, this individual will help deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative technology solutions while gaining exposure to modern cloud platforms, enterprise architecture, and large\-scale financial systems.

**business description**


blackstone technology \& innovations (bxti) is the technology organization at the core of blackstone's businesses and growth initiatives. serving both internal and external clients, bxti develops the next generation of systems that manage risk, drive operational efficiency, and improve transparency across the firm and its broad ecosystem of investors and portfolio companies.


bxti is entrepreneurial, and highly collaborative. our open and iterative development approach enables engineers to make meaningful contributions from day one. we are problem solvers who take ideas from concept to implementation, leveraging modern technologies and strong partnerships with business stakeholders. through active mentoring and a culture of continuous learning, we empower our teams to deliver innovative solutions that help maintain blackstone's competitive advantage.

**position overview**


the procurement technology team is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and supporting business\-critical applications that enable procurement operations across blackstone. these platforms support supplier onboarding, purchasing, invoice processing, analytics, and integrations with enterprise systems and third\-party solutions.


as an associate software development engineer, you will contribute to the development of scalable applications, apis, and integrations that drive operational efficiency and transparency across the procurement ecosystem. you will work closely with product owners, business stakeholders, and technology teams to deliver high\-quality solutions while supporting and enhancing existing platforms.


this role offers the opportunity to gain exposure to modern cloud technologies, enterprise integrations, data platforms, and end\-to\-end software development within one of the world's leading alternative asset management firms.

**key responsibilities**

* collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to design, develop, test, and maintain applications and integration services that support the procurement technology ecosystem.
* develop and support apis, data integrations, and enterprise services that connect internal systems with third\-party procurement and finance platforms.
* participate in the design and implementation of new technology solutions, ensuring delivery of scalable, secure, and high\-quality software.
* support production applications and integrations by troubleshooting issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing both immediate and long\-term solutions.
* contribute to platform modernization and cloud infrastructure initiatives, including automation, monitoring, performance optimization, and deployment improvements.
* collaborate with stakeholders during the onboarding and integration of new third\-party applications and vendors.
* participate in code reviews and promote software engineering best practices, including maintainability, performance, security, and testing.
* work within agile development teams to deliver solutions aligned with business priorities and timelines.
* utilize monitoring and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues impacting system reliability and performance.
* thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment with evolving priorities and business needs.

**qualifications**


blackstone seeks to hire individuals who work well in collaborative environments, demonstrate intellectual curiosity, exercise sound judgment, and have a proven track record of excellence.

**required qualifications**

* bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 3\+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, or technology operations.
* experience developing applications using c\#, python, or similar object\-oriented programming languages.
* strong computer science fundamentals, including object\-oriented design principles, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
* experience designing, developing, or consuming restful apis and integration services.
* strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with experience working with both sql and nosql databases.
* experience working with cloud\-based platforms such as amazon web services (aws) or microsoft azure.
* familiarity with ci/cd pipelines, automated deployments, and modern software development practices.
* experience working within agile software development environments.
* strong verbal and written communication skills and can effectively partner with both technical and business stakeholders.
* work effectively within distributed teams and adapt to evolving business priorities.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with procurement, source\-to\-pay (s2p), supplier management, or enterprise finance technology platforms.
* experience integrating with enterprise procurement or erp systems such as coupa, sap, oracle, ariba, workday, or similar platforms.
* experience with modern web application frameworks such as react or angular.
* familiarity with data warehousing technologies such as snowflake.
* experience with ai related concepts like mcp, agents, rag, and ai coding tools like claude code.
* knowledge of event\-driven architecture, messaging systems, and distributed applications.
* experience utilizing application monitoring, observability, and logging platforms.
* experience within financial services, asset management, or other highly regulated industries.

**what you'll gain**

* exposure to enterprise\-scale software development, integrations, and cloud technologies.
* opportunities to work directly with business stakeholders and influence critical procurement processes.
* mentorship and career development within a high\-performing technology organization.
* experience delivering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and operational excellence across one of the world's leading asset management firms.

  

the duties and responsibilities described here are not exhaustive and additional assignments, duties, or responsibilities may be required of this position. assignments, duties, and responsibilities may be changed at any time, with or without notice, by blackstone in its sole discretion.

$135,000 \- $170,000
actual base salary within that range will be determined by several components including but not limited to the individual's experience, skills, qualifications and job location. for roles located outside of the us, please disregard the posted salary bands as these roles will follow a separate compensation process based on local market comparables.  

  

additional compensation and benefits offered in connection with the role consist of comprehensive health benefits, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, and fsa benefits; paid time off; life insurance; 401(k) plan; and discretionary bonuses. certain employees may also be eligible for equity and other incentive compensation at blackstone’s sole discretion.

title: Software Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
job title: software quality assurance analyst


location: boise, id (remote)


**summaryof responsibilities**


theidaho department of health and welfare (idhw) requires a software qualityassurance analyst 3 (sqaa3\) to build and support automated testing frameworksand tests that will be used to verify that programs function according to userrequirements and conform to established standards. the software qualityassurance analyst will build (write code) and support automated testing, with aspecific emphasis on the creation, execution, and management of automated testsacross all levels of testing, including unit, functional, integration, useracceptance, and production deployment validation testing. idhw seeks acandidate with demonstrated skills and experience in building automated testingframeworks. the candidate needs to have experience and expertise in creatingtest plans and test scripts from the customer's perspective to ensure thatautomation delivers the intended results and satisfies the specified businessrequirements. they will build automation to meet the technical needs ofreusability, sustainability, and open standards, and to maximize the return onthe investment in automation.


weare seeking a quality assurance engineer with strong experience in softwaretesting and a growing focus on ai\-driven quality practices. this role combinestraditional qa disciplines with modern ai/ml testing strategies, includingvalidating ai models, automating test flows with ai\-assisted tooling, andimproving product quality using intelligent test frameworks.


thisproject is being developed using the scrum (agile) development methodology. thecandidate should have demonstrated experience with executing and managingautomated testing in an agile development environment.


**key responsibilities**


theperson filling this position should have the ability to do the followingassignments:


develop, update, and maintain testingstandards and procedures.


use ai\-driven tooling to improve testcoverage, defect detection, and regression reliability.


understand test plans, test scripts, testcases, and links that connect to requirements and done criteria.


manage test case repository and maintain testcases up to date.


participate in collaborative working sessionsto develop test plans and test criteria.


design an automation framework using seleniumwebdriver, java, and jenkins infrastructure.


be responsible for maintaining the automationframework and regression test suites.


be responsible for the planning and controlof test environments.


analyze and interact with complex sets ofautomated test assets and provide insights into alternatives or improvements totest systems, test framework components, test databases, and test servers.


provide solutions and recommendations for theexecution of automated tests and troubleshoot test failures.

partners with other qa's and architects to develop and establish quality assurance standards and best practices


performs and coordinates system verification and validation test activities utilizing various tools

experience:


integrating automated testing processes,solving complex quality assurance data\-processing problems, and designing andimplementing test automation frameworks.

* knowledge and/or experience with automated regression test strategies and tools

**soft skills**


* strong communication skills and collaboration abilities.
* able to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

title: Account Engineer
description:
at snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. to usher in this new era, we seek ai\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. you don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating ai as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. we look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. at snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


as an **account engineer**, you’ll play a key role in delivering technical expertise and building relationships with prospects and customers as they explore the snowflake ai data cloud. this is a fantastic opportunity to grow your career, develop your skills, and make an impact in a supportive and dynamic environment.


you’ll work alongside experienced team members, contributing to a variety of customer engagements, from technical evaluations to inspiring future\-state architectures. this role blends technical problem\-solving, collaboration, and customer focus, making it an exciting step for someone looking to grow into a technical customer\-facing role.

**what you'll do:**

* **support customer engagements:** assist in presenting snowflake’s technology and vision to diverse audiences, from technical contributors to business leaders. develop your skills in aligning technical solutions with business outcomes.
* **contribute to technical wins:** collaborate with customers to plan and execute technical evaluations and proof\-of\-concept demonstrations, supported by senior team members. help tailor solutions to customer needs while learning how to communicate business value effectively.
* **learn \& build relationships:** partner with customers and technical champions to foster trust and collaboration. build your expertise in championing snowflake’s capabilities and contributing to long\-term customer success.
* **develop technical expertise:** gain hands\-on experience through tailored demos, hands\-on labs, and snowflake’s extensive learning resources. stay informed about industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies.
* **collaborate for success:** work closely with account executives, marketing, and snowflake’s partner ecosystem to ensure customers realize the value of snowflake.
* **grow as a professional:** take advantage of mentorship opportunities, on\-the\-job learning, and a team that’s invested in your development.

**minimum qualifications:**

* **communication skills:** ability to communicate effectively with diverse audiences, both written and verbal.
* **customer focus:** a desire to understand customer challenges and deliver meaningful solutions.
* **team player:** a collaborative approach to working with peers, partners, and customers.

**preferred qualifications:**

* working with modern data technologies like snowflake, databricks, fabric, bigquery etc (including ci/cd tooling, spark, containers, devops tools, orchestration tools, git).
* understanding public cloud platforms (aws, azure, gcp) and their services.

at snowflake, we prioritize collaboration, curiosity, and a growth mindset. you’ll be part of a supportive team where learning and development are celebrated. we foster a culture of inclusion, empathy, and mutual respect, ensuring everyone has the opportunity to contribute and thrive.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
data analyticshybrid remote, overland park, kansas  




### **description**


**at mmgy global**, we believe nothing shapes your view of the world like travel. so every day, we share our clients’ stories from a perspective that inspires people to see the world differently. our personalized service and strategy connect media, consumers and influencers across the globe, taking people to new places and changing their views for the better. at mmgy, we inspire people to go places.

**we have an immediate opening for a senior data analyst in our overland park, ks office.**


as a key piece of the data strategy and analytics team, the senior data analyst will leverage media, measurement, and data analytics experience to serve as a senior individual contributor on mmgy's data strategy team, reporting to the svp of data. this role is responsible for translating available data resources into actionable insights and strategic recommendations for internal teams and external clients, and for supporting mmgy media via performance analytics for select clients. the ideal candidate operates with the autonomy, client presence, and strategic judgment – owning workstreams end to end and representing data strategy in client\-facing setting.

**duties \& responsibilities**


data strategy \& audience intelligence

* collaborate with mmgy account, media, social, paid search, creative, and martech teams to understand available client data sources, tools, and partnerships with the goal of translating data into value for the mmgy media client base.
* support and independently execute audience segmentation and modeling projects in partnership with account management and integrated planning leaders, including data analysis, insights creation, and client presentations.
* execute strategies related to mmgy audience products, including trips and terminal (mmgy’s audience modeling and persona creation process) audiences, from analysis through activation.
* conduct share of wallet competitive analysis for mmgy media and data strategy clients, capturing client organizational goals, securing data to conduct analysis, and communicating results with go\-forward strategy recommendations.
* conduct seasonal market and audience analysis and deliver recommendations to the mmgy media team in line with seasonal planning efforts.
* support offline performance matchback reporting in partnership with consumer database providers.
* partner with mmgy travel intelligence to refine terminal, trips, and other data strategy products, and research the latest technology and travel insight trends to maintain their usp and relevance.
* be proactive in discovering new ways to highlight the value and communicate the specifics of mmgy data strategy products.
* collaborate with mmgy’s audience activation partners and sellers, driving revenue through mmgy audience usage within and outside the walls of mmgy media activation; track and report audience sale revenue in partnership with mmgy finance team


database management and data collection

* analyze results, visualize performance, and identify trends that provide actionable insights based on available data, connecting media delivery data to client business outcomes.
* operationalize existing data strategy processes via standardization and automation — building repeatable, scalable workflows (sql, bigquery, scripting) that reduce manual effort and improve turnaround.
* create well\-organized, client\-ready analysis presentations that lead with insight and recommendation rather than data description.
* leadership \& collaboration
* provide thought leadership in internal meetings, delivering specific, influential recommendations supported by data and analysis.
* serve as a primary representative for data strategy in meetings, both internal and with clients, including onboarding, client visits, and key reporting periods for the assigned portfolio.
* build relationships and trust with key client stakeholders, operating as a strategic partner rather than a report producer.
* provide informal training, direction, and guidance to analysts across the broader analytics organization; contribute to best\-practice documentation and knowledge sharing.
* hold self accountable to all client and internal deadlines, proactively flagging risks and managing expectations with minimal oversight.


required skills and experience

* bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or related technical field is required.
* 5\+ years of relevant professional experience in data analytics, audience modeling. performance tracking and analysis, and cross\-channel program measurement, ideally within a media or marketing agency environment.
* strong working knowledge of web analytics and ad serving tools (google analytics 4, adobe analytics, google campaign manager 360\).
* strong working knowledge of sql and cloud data warehouse environments (bigquery preferred), with the ability to independently query, join, and qa large multi\-platform datasets.
* strong working knowledge and experience using data visualization software (tableau, power bi, looker studio) for client dashboard reporting, plus proficiency in microsoft excel.
* demonstrated ability to own projects end to end: scoping, analysis, insight development, and client presentation.
* attention to detail and the ability to work in a team and collaborate with and influence others, including senior internal stakeholders and clients.
* proactive, self\-motivated, deals well with ambiguity, strong time management, and excellent written and oral communication skills, including presentation delivery to client audiences.


preferred skills and experience


experience with audience data, segmentation, and consumer databases (e.g., epsilon, experian, mri\-simmons) and * ing them to media planning and activation.
* experience automating reporting and data workflows using scripting (python, google apps script) or workflow tools.
* experience in travel, tourism, hospitality, or destination marketing, or a demonstrated interest in the category.
* familiarity with media mix concepts, incrementality, and matchback measurement approaches.
* experience mentoring or training junior analysts, even without formal management responsibility.
* experience with campaign and website tagging and tracking systems (google tag manager, floodlight, tag auditing and troubleshooting).


mmgy global provides a comprehensive pto \+ benefits package that includes a hybrid telework policy. applicants for employment in the u.s. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa. mmgy global is an equal opportunity employer.

**who are we?** we’re a travel\-obsessed collective of more than 600 people across the country and around the globe. and when we say we inspire people to go places, we mean all people. that’s why we’re focused on nurturing a workforce that is representative of the places we visit.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
at roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. this is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. join roche, where every voice matters.
  
  

the position
  
  

at roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action \- we believe that good business means a better world. that is why we come to work every single day. we commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. we do this today to build a better tomorrow.
  
  

roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. we strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.
  
  

operations near patient care (dob) is a key pillar within global diagnostic operations. thanks to the systematic improvement of our cost structure, continuous optimizations, and efficiency enhancements, we are successfully positioning ourselves for growth in our environment
  
  

the opportunity
  
  

be part of our journey. as asenior data analyst in our near patient care manufacturing environment, you will develop and deliver data analytics solutions that help us understand, monitor and improve product and process performance across our portfolios, including cgm.
  
  

in this role, you will act as a data product owner for selected analytics solutions and data products. you will translate business and process needs into clear analytical requirements, guide end\-to\-end delivery from problem framing to implementation and continuous improvement, and ensure that solutions are aligned with global data, platform and governance standards.
  
  

you will combine strong analytical expertise with a solid understanding of manufacturing processes, it/ot systems and data engineering fundamentals. you will work hands\-on where needed, while also providing technical guidance to colleagues and coordinating cross\-functional teams to solve complex, high\-impact problems.
  
  

main tasks of the position
  
  

* end\-to\-end data product ownership: own and drive selected data products and analytics solutions with focus on cgm 2\.0 (dot) across their lifecycle, from business need, requirements and prioritization to development, testing, release, usage, continuous improvement and phase\-out.
* business translation\& process analysis: work closely with manufacturing, quality, planning and digital stakeholders to understand process challenges, translate them into data and analytics requirements, and assess data needs based on operational value, feasibility, quality impact and scalability.
* advanced analysis\& monitoring: independently perform complex analyses and establish effective process data monitoring to identify performance variation, prevent incidents and support the avoidance of quality deviations.
* predictive system modeling: apply analytical thinking, data science methods and professional judgment to evaluate, select and implement approaches for predicting system and process performance.
* data engineering\& platform alignment: contribute hands\-on to data preparation, data modelling, data quality checks and analytical implementation where required, and collaborate closely with data engineers and platform teams to ensure robust, scalable and maintainable solutions.
* data governance\& compliance: contribute to data product governance and ensure that analytics solutions are developed in line with relevant data integrity, compliance, documentation and global platform requirements, including alignment with go digital 2\.0 / roche diagnostics data mesh principles where applicable.
* technical leadership: coordinate task distribution within cross\-functional analytics work packages, provide expert guidance to colleagues and act as a best\-practices resource for data analytics, data product delivery and analytical problem solving.
* stakeholder\& performance management: proactively identify sources of product and process performance variation through data analysis, experiments and close collaboration with subject matter experts, ensuring that insights are translated into future data product and process improvements.
* cross\-functional collaboration: foster effective cooperation with manufacturing, quality, planning, it/ot, global digital teams and other relevant interfaces to resolve delivery failures, customer\-visible product performance problems and operational improvement opportunities.
* decision support: support leadership and operational teams by preparing, analyzing and communicating technical reports, performance insights and decision\-relevant analytics in a clear, actionable way.
* travel required: up to 20% international travel.


**who you are:**  

* bachelor degree in engineering, computer science, data science, business administration, or a related field is required.
* 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing, production processes, data analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a closely related field.


**preferred qualifications:**  

* strong understanding of manufacturing and quality processes, with the ability to analyze process flows, identify performance drivers and translate operational challenges into prioritized data and analytics requirements.
* experience in owning or leading analytics solutions, data products or cross\-functional data initiatives from requirements definition through implementation and continuous improvement.
* strong analytical and technical skills, including hands\-on experience with data analysis, data preparation and data visualization. experience with sql, python, r or comparable tools is highly desirable.
* good understanding of data engineering fundamentals, including databases, data models, etl/elt concepts, data pipelines, data quality, lineage and scalable data product design.
* deep understanding of it/ot systems, digital solutions, analytics models and business system landscapes within manufacturing, quality control, planning and related reporting frameworks.
* excellent knowledge of data analytics, data product / data mesh principles and relevant systems such as snowflake, tableau and other bi tools.
* understanding of data governance, data integrity, gxp / csv\-relevant documentation principles and compliance expectations in a regulated manufacturing environment is beneficial.
* proven ability to guide colleagues, coordinate work packages, influence without formal authority and lead cross\-functional teams through complex analytical problem solving.
* strong decision\-making ability, structured thinking and the ability to manage priorities, resources and stakeholder expectations in a complex matrix environment.
* fluency in english is required. german language skills are beneficial to enable effective collaboration with local teams and international stakeholders.


**additional information:**  

* location: the location is at our indianapolis, in office or mannheim, germany.
* relocation benefits are not provided with this job posting.


the expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of indianapolis is $116,900 \- $217,100\. actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job\-related factors permitted by law. a discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and company performance. this position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
  
benefits
  
  

where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. for this role, the primary location is indianapolis. if you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
  
  

who we are
  
  

a healthier future drives us to innovate. together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our diagnostics products. we empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
